title: Returns & exchanges
content:
# Returns & exchanges

Customers may return unused physical products within 30 days of delivery. Items must be in their original packaging with proof of purchase. A return after 20 days is eligible if those conditions are met. Personalized items and digital downloads are not returnable.

Start a return from Orders > Request a return. Select the item and reason, then download the prepaid return label. Standard returns are free. Exchanges use the same process; choose Exchange and select the replacement size or color.

title: Refunds & payment timing
content:
# Refunds & payment timing

Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5–10 business days after the warehouse receives and inspects the returned item. Bank processing may take additional time. We cannot refund a different card or bank account.

If a refund is missing after 10 business days, contact support with your order number and return tracking number. Original expedited shipping charges are not refundable unless the item arrived damaged or incorrect.

title: Shipping & delivery
content:
# Shipping & delivery

Standard shipping takes 3–5 business days after dispatch and is free on orders of €50 or more. Orders under €50 have a €4.90 standard shipping fee. Express shipping takes 1–2 business days and costs €9.90.

Orders ship Monday through Friday, excluding public holidays. The tracking link appears in Orders and in the dispatch email. If tracking shows delivered but the parcel is missing, check nearby delivery locations and contact support within 48 hours. International shipping is currently available only within the European Union.

title: Account access & security
content:
# Account access & security

To reset a forgotten password, select Forgot password on the sign-in page and enter your account email. The reset link expires after 30 minutes. Check spam if the email does not arrive. Request a new link if yours has expired.

Enable two-factor authentication under Settings > Security using an authenticator app. Save the recovery codes in a secure place. If you lose access to both your authenticator and recovery codes, contact support for identity verification. Never share passwords or one-time codes with support.

title: Subscriptions & billing
content:
# Subscriptions & billing

The Starter subscription costs €12 per month and the Pro subscription costs €29 per month, excluding applicable taxes. Both renew monthly. Download invoices from Settings > Billing > Invoices. You can update your payment card in Settings > Billing > Payment method.

Cancel your subscription from Settings > Billing > Cancel subscription. Access continues until the end of the current paid period. Cancellation prevents the next renewal; it does not automatically refund the current period. To investigate a duplicate charge, send support the invoice numbers; do not send full card details.

title: App troubleshooting
content:
# App troubleshooting

If the web app will not load, refresh the page, check your internet connection, disable browser extensions, and try a private browsing window. Support covers the two most recent major versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge.

For upload failures, check that the file is PDF, Markdown, or plain text and smaller than 5 MB. Scanned image-only PDFs need OCR before uploading. If an error continues, send support the error message, approximate time, browser version, and steps to reproduce. Never include passwords or payment credentials in a screenshot.

title: Changing & cancelling orders
content:
# Changing & cancelling orders

You can change the delivery address or cancel an order within one hour of purchase, as long as it has not been dispatched. Open Orders, select the order, and choose Edit address or Cancel order.

Once dispatched, an order cannot be edited or cancelled. Wait for delivery and use the standard return process if eligible. For a damaged item, contact support within seven days of delivery with your order number and a photo of the damage. Support will arrange a replacement or refund after review.

title: Data export & deletion
content:
# Data export & deletion

Request a copy of your account data from Settings > Privacy > Export data. An export download link is emailed within 72 hours and remains valid for seven days.

Request account deletion from Settings > Privacy > Delete account. You must confirm by email. Deletion is completed within 30 days after confirmation. Some billing records may be retained where legally required. Deleting your account also cancels future subscription renewals. Contact support before deletion if you have an unresolved order or refund.
